text:
Nora: hi all, first day here. trying to trigger the infra repo workflow via 'Run workflow' but GitHub shows: 'You don’t have permission to run this workflow'.
Nora: pushed a trivial readme change and no workflow run was queued.
Leon: welcome! if your org membership is pending GH will block Actions/manual runs. can you see the org membership page?
Nora: I can see the invite but the SSO link I accepted earlier shows pending still.
Jamal: that explains it. Buildkite maps team membership to agent tokens, so a 403 there can cause the BK agent auth error too.
Buildkite Bot: Build #912 failed: agent authentication failed (403 Forbidden).
Nora: Buildkite error pasted:
2026-03-21T09:14:02Z ERROR agent: failed to authenticate: 403 Forbidden - token not authorized
Nora: `gh auth status` shows i'm logged in as @nora but membership still pending.
Leon: i'll approve your org membership and add you to ci-runners temporarily so you can finish onboarding checks. try logging out of gh cli and back in after.
Nora: okay i see the approve notice now, re-logged in and retried. manual run button is available and the pipeline was picked up by an agent. first build passed. 
Jamal: awesome — welcome aboard! Leon, can we add a note in the onboarding doc about SSO sometimes leaving membership as pending and the manual approve step?
Leon: yes, i'll update onboarding -> ci. Nora, if you still need any repo secrets or service account access, ping infra-ops.
Nora: thanks all, updating my checklist and closing my onboarding tasks. :wave:
